    # Even elements at even indices are ignored

    # Empty list

    # Single element (no odd indices)

    # Two elements, odd index even
    assert add([1, 4]) == 4
    assert add([1, 3]) == 0
    # Negative even numbers at odd indices
    assert add([1, -2, 3, -4]) == -6
    # Zero at odd index counts as even
    assert add([1, 0, 3, 0]) == 0
    # All even numbers at odd indices
    assert add([0, 2, 0, 4, 0, 6]) == 12
    print("All tests passed!")

def test_add():
    # Even element at odd index should be included
    assert add([4, 2, 6, 7]) == 2  # only lst[1]=2 is even

    assert add([1, 1]) == 0

    # Empty list edge case
    assert add([]) == 0

    # Single element list (no odd index)
    assert add([2]) == 0
    assert add([5]) == 0

    # Even element at even index should be excluded
    assert add([2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]) == 0  # even values all at even indices

    # Zeros are even
    assert add([1, 0, 1, 0]) == 0  # 0 + 0

    assert add([1, -2, 3, -4]) == -6  # -2 + -4

    # Larger mixed list
    assert add([10, 20, 30, 41, 50, 62, 70, 81]) == 20 + 62  # indices 1 and 5

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_add()
